ActorTalk: If the numbers are right, it should go here...
You're right. Art should be seen. Thank you, Gray Raven Commandant.
The artist was a friend of mine. He died on Earth not long ago... We were packing up his work to send home as a keepsake.
But I've changed my mind. I want to talk to his family, and with their blessing, keep his spirit here.
Anyway... thank you, Gray Raven Commandant.
